summary: Ecopetrol S.A., the Colombian state-controlled energy company, filed a Form 6-K announcing the fulfillment of conditions to acquire a 49% interest in the JK1 and JK2 wind projects in La Guajira from AES Colombia. The aggregate acquisition value is approximately USD 25.5 million, with the projects having 259 MW capacity and a 35-km transmission line. The transaction is structured through a special-purpose vehicle (autonomous patrimony). Ecopetrol had previously disclosed an Investment Framework Agreement on April 14, 2025. The board recommends the transaction for energy transition goals. Watch for closing of remaining four projects in the wind cluster.
